correctness.rationale: Independent exact Lindblad adjoint closure gives two damped (z_j,w_j) blocks and r=z1 z2+w1 w2. Majorana partial time reversal yields Hermitian 2x2 spectral blocks with radicands (1+r)^2+(w1-w2)^2 and (1-r)^2+(w1+w2)^2; their squared difference reduces to 4z1z2 and establishes leading singular degeneracy exactly at a one-site parity zero. Matrix-exponential solution provides the cos/cosh zero equations and first-root arccos/arccosh expression, with exceptional point s=1 handled continuously. Independently constructed all 16 Liouvillian basis columns and expm-evolved a Fock projector at gamma1=.3,gamma2=2.3,J=1 and t=0,.2,.5,.9, reproducing all five analytic coefficients within 6e-16. Inspected separate symbolic Pauli/twist verifier. The classification concerns spectral degeneracy, not negativity positivity or generic multi-site states.

final_claim: For the H=-J X1X2 two-mode Kitaev dimer under sitewise-balanced (but unequal across sites) fermionic gain/loss and occupation-product initialization, the largest two twisted-negativity singular levels meet iff z1 z2=0. The first finite crossing is [arccos(s)/sqrt(1-s^2),1,arccosh(s)/sqrt(s^2-1)]/(2J) for s=|gamma2-gamma1|/(4J) in the three respective regimes; above s>=1 only the higher-rate site closes at finite time.
